# Qomash Wears

Qomash Wears is a Pakistani online clothing store for women and men — premium embroidered suits, casual streetwear, winter wear and shawls — with cash on delivery and 14-day easy exchange across Pakistan.

## Shop
- Home: https://www.qomashwears.store/
- Shop all products: https://www.qomashwears.store/shop
- New arrivals: https://www.qomashwears.store/shop?sort=newest
- Sale: https://www.qomashwears.store/shop?sale=1
- Women: https://www.qomashwears.store/shop?category=women
- Men: https://www.qomashwears.store/shop?category=men
- Winter collection: https://www.qomashwears.store/shop?category=winter
- Footwear: https://www.qomashwears.store/shop?category=footwear
- Accessories: https://www.qomashwears.store/shop?category=accessories

## Company
- Payments: cash on delivery (COD), JazzCash, Easypaisa
- Shipping: flat Rs 250, free on orders above Rs 3,000; delivery 3–5 working days nationwide
- Exchanges: 14-day easy exchange on unused items
- Support: Mon–Sat, 9am–6pm; WhatsApp ordering available
- Blog: https://www.qomashwears.store/blog
